about: Ladder stats reduced from the fixture under smogon/2026-09 (Smogon's real M-C doubles files at 1760, cut down to 27 Pokémon; LadderFixtures has the details). Recorded by the backend's LadderGoldenFileTest, which checks it; the app's SmogonLadder.reduce checks against it too, so both make the same record from Smogon's files. Shares are 0 to 1, of the Pokémon's own weight (the sum of its ability counts), rounded half to even at five places; usage and leadShare are as Smogon publishes them.
